observations: Photo 0 shows a CRT television with a black screen.
The screen displays a white loading or power-on icon.
The TV is sitting on a concrete floor.
The LG logo is visible on the bottom bezel.
The TV casing shows significant dust and wear.
The photo is taken from a distance, obscuring the exact size and condition of the screen.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the LG logo on the bottom bezel
photo 0 shows a loading icon on the screen

claims.claim: being sold as is for parts or recycling
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows a used and dusty unit

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen, remote included. Never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The CRT may be physically damaged or have a dead or flickering screen.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the screen powered on showing a test pattern or a video.

risks.risk: The TV may be missing the power supply or other internal components.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the TV showing the power cord and the rear panel.

risks.risk: The TV may be too large to be practical for the buyer's space.
risks.proof: A photo of the TV with a measuring tape or a reference object.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the screen powered on to confirm it is not dead.
Photo of the back of the TV to check for missing parts.
Photo of the TV powered on showing a video to confirm the screen works.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
